mainEntity.name: What is tiny home zoning and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiny home zoning refers to local regulations that dictate where and how tiny homes can be legally placed. These rules cover aspects like minimum lot size, foundation requirements, and whether a tiny home can be considered a primary residence or an accessory dwelling unit (ADU). Understanding zoning is crucial because it determines if you can legally build or place a tiny home on a specific property, ensuring compliance and avoiding potential fines or demolition orders.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny home zoning defines local rules for placing tiny homes, covering aspects like lot size and foundation. It's important for legal compliance and to ensure your tiny home can be built or placed where you intend.
